description.value: The Lodge Motor Inn is a 40-room motel centrally located in Dawson Creek on the Alaska Highway, a primary northern BC cycling corridor, offering 24-hour check-in and wheelchair-accessible rooms. The property is part of a small family-run chain with locations in Dawson Creek and Grande Prairie, known for clean, quiet rooms and friendly service. An on-site café operates in the same building, though its current status is unclear from the website.

address.value: 1317 Alaska Avenue, Dawson Creek, BC V1G 1Z4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Lodge Motor Inn at 1317 Alaska Avenue, Dawson Creek, BC is an actively operating motel with 24-hour check-in, 40 rooms, and an on-site café; the contact page corroborates the OSM address exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere across the site's pages. Wi-Fi is confirmed via OSM tag internet_access=wlan and is listed as a standard amenity at the sister Grande Prairie property on the same website; laundry is mentioned only for the Grande Prairie location, not Dawson Creek.
concerns: Conflicting café status: the Dawson Creek location page states 'The Lodge Café is currently closed due to COVID19,' but the /the-lodge-cafe/ subpage says it has re-opened under Chef Trio's Kitchen — one of these pages is outdated.
OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-782-4837 sourced from website contact page.
Laundry facilities are described only for the Grande Prairie location; it is unclear whether Dawson Creek offers the same.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The motel is a real, operating accommodation on the Alaska Highway cycling corridor, but no cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, procedures, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website; human outreach is needed to determine if it meets WWC required criteria.

wow_evidence: small family-run chain with locations in Dawson Creek and Grande Prairie
